posts.community: IDFC First Bank Limited - First Bank Preference for Long Term Investors too?
posts.text: IDFC has picked up FCNR worth around 3.57billion dollars. I understand that it will provide an additional PAT of around 120 crores per quarter. In Q2 the benefit will be partial and full benefit will accrue from Q3 onwards. Let us hope that we see a better Q2, followed by better Q3 and Q4. ROA of 1+ is now assured for fy27. The concall of Q2 will provide more clarity.
